questions.prompt: Which of these countries share a land border with Germany?
questions.fact: Germany has nine land neighbours, from Denmark in the north round to Austria and Switzerland in the south.

questions.prompt: Which of these animals are mammals?
questions.fact: The platypus lays eggs and still feeds its young on milk, which is the rule that makes it a mammal.

questions.prompt: How many years did the Hundred Years' War actually last?
questions.fact: 116 years, from 1337 to 1453, with long truces in between. The name came later.

questions.prompt: How many chromosomes are in most human cells?
questions.fact: 46, in 23 pairs: one of each pair from your mother and one from your father.

questions.prompt: Which film won the first ever Oscar for Best Animated Feature?
questions.hint: The award was first given in 2002, for a film from 2001.
questions.fact: Shrek beat Monsters, Inc. to the award, which the Academy had only just created.

questions.prompt: Which country has the most islands?
questions.hint: Think Scandinavia, and count the tiny ones.
questions.fact: Sweden counts about 267,000 islands, and only around a thousand of them are inhabited.
